name: fly_in_every_room
description: The jet boots work in every room, not only rooms carrying the triangle symbol.
evidence: $2685 loads $A6 and branches past both thrust polls when it is zero, so $A6 is the jet boot enable: with it clear, neither INKEY $B7 nor INKEY $97 is read and $0E never gains upward velocity
$1B98 draw_and_initialise_room clears $A6 at $1BAA, in a run of stores sharing the LDA #$00 at $1BA4, so every room starts with the boots disabled
$167A writes LDA #$01 into $A6 while a particular cell is drawn, taken 13 times against 110 for that cell handler in the traces, which is the room granting flight as its symbol is painted
the player reports flying in rooms showing a triangle symbol, 1,0 and 2,0, and not in 3,0 or 3,1, which matches a flag granted by drawing one specific cell
the traces bear the split out: the BEQ at $2687 was taken 765 times against 2086 fall-throughs, so the boots were disabled for a quarter of the polls already recorded
$2685 is the only reader: the apparent BIT $A6 at $3111 is the last byte of the JSR $244E operand at $310F, not an instruction
the thrust keys are INKEY -73 and -105, which are matrix row 4 column 8 and row 6 column 8, the BBC : and / keys; the title screen names them * and ? because those are the shifted legends
qualifications: LDA #$01 replaces LDA $A6 rather than the store at $1BAA, because that store shares its zero with ten others in the same run and cannot be retargeted in place
A is not read after the branch - $2689 loads X immediately - and LDA #$01 leaves Z clear, so the branch is never taken and nothing downstream sees a different accumulator
$A6 is left doing its real job: it is still cleared per room and still set by the symbol, so anything else that comes to depend on it is unaffected. Only the poll ignores it
flight in a room the designer did not intend it in can reach places the room was not built for; this is a deliberate cheat, not a bug fix
